出生地: 美国,伊利诺伊州,芝加哥
简介: Craig Phillip Robinson (born October 25, 1971) is an American actor, stand-up comedian and singer. He is best known for his roles on The Office as Darryl Philbin and in the films Pineapple Express, Miss March, Zack and Miri Make a Porno, Shrek Forever After, Knocked Up and Hot Tub Time Machine.
